DIAGNOSIS READY: Hodgkin Lymphoma

The description of a painless, fixed, and recently enlarging supraclavicular node alongside B-symptoms (fever, night sweats, weight loss) is highly suggestive of a lymphoproliferative disorder. While the patient mentioned bowel symptoms earlier, the prominence of the supraclavicular node warrants immediate investigation for malignancy. I need to confirm the nature of the node and check for other systemic signs.
